content: पुरा {%ind.%} .²1 In former times, formerly, of yore, in the olden time; पुरा शक्रमुपस्थाय <ls>R. 1. 75</ls>; पुरा सरसि मानसे … यस्य यातं वयः <ls>Bv. 1. 3</ls>; <ls>Ms. 1. 119</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">5. 22</ls>. .²2 Before, hitherto, upto the present time .²3 At first, in the first place; रामं दर्शय मे शीघ्रं पुरा मेऽर्थोऽतिवर्तते <ls>Rām. 7. 105. 2</ls>. .²4 In a short time, soon, ere-long, shortly (in this sense usually with a present tense to which it gives a future sense); पुरा सप्तद्वीपां जयति वसुधामप्रतिरथः <ls>Ś. 7. 33</ls>; पुरा दूषयति स्थलीम् <ls>R. 12. 30</ls>; आलोके ते निपतति पुरा सा बलिव्याकुला वा <ls>Me. 87</ls>; <ls>N. 1. 18</ls>; <ls>Śi. 10. 56</ls>; <ls>Ki. 10. 50</ls>, <ls n="Ki.">11. 36</ls>. .²5 <ab>Ved.</ab> For the defence of. .²6 Securely from. .²7 Except, besides.
पुरा .²1 An epithet of the Ganges. .²2 A kind of perfume. .²3 The east. .²4 A castle. See पुरम्.
